Objective: Least privilege and need-to-know; no wildcard permissions in production

Objective: Quarterly recertification for CDE/production; semi-annual for corporate IT; revocation within 5 business days

Business use primary; incidental personal use permissible within four stated conditions
Prohibits unauthorized data access/exfiltration, circumventing controls, unauthorized software, shadow IT, credential sharing, malicious code
Prohibits illegal content, financial fraud, personal commercial activity, harassment, identity misrepresentation

System monitoring disclosed; no employee expectation of privacy; monitoring governed by Employee Privacy Notice
Obligation to report violations; non-retaliation policy; suspected breaches escalated to Legal/Compliance

Restricted/Confidential data must carry classification labels in docs, email subjects, DB fields, and physical documents

Objective: Confidential data: managed systems only, TLS or encrypted email, DPA/NDA for third-party sharing

All personnel must report suspected incidents within 2 hours; no self-remediation without IT Security authorization

Annual tabletop exercise; involves IT Security, Engineering, Legal, HR; lessons incorporated within 30 days

Centralized vendor inventory in VMS; records risk tier, business owner, data types, compliance status

DPA required for vendors processing personal data; cardholder data vendors acknowledge PCI DSS Req 12.8.2 responsibility
Right to Audit clause in all Tier 1 contracts; Compliance Lead may invoke proactively on failed certifications
Tier 1 vendors re-assessed annually; Tier 2 biennially; verify security posture and least-privilege access
Vendor breach notification to FinNexus within 24 hrs; IT Security integrates into IR plan; Legal directs regulatory notifications
Vendor offboarding: access revoked within 4 hrs; Certificate of Destruction for Restricted/Confidential data within 30 days

12-password history enforced in AD/IdP; no reuse across systems or for personal external accounts

Account lockout after 10 consecutive failures; 30-min lockout duration; customer platforms must rate-limit + CAPTCHA

Service accounts: mTLS/OAuth 2.0/restricted tokens; no interactive login; credentials dynamically injected via Vault/Secrets Manager
